skills.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

skills.name: Glitterlance
skills.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.

skills.name: Whimsy
skills.description: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

skills.name: Help, Pix!
skills.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

skills.name: Wild Growth
skills.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

skills.name: Illumination
skills.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

skills.name: Light Binding
skills.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

skills.name: Prismatic Barrier
skills.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

skills.name: Lucent Singularity
skills.description: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

skills.name: Final Spark
skills.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

skills.name: Granite Shield
skills.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

skills.name: Seismic Shard
skills.description: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Thunderclap
skills.description: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.

skills.name: Ground Slam
skills.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

skills.name: Unstoppable Force
skills.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

skills.name: Void Shift
skills.description: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

skills.name: Call of the Void
skills.description: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

skills.name: Void Swarm
skills.description: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: Malefic Visions
skills.description: Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.

skills.name: Nether Grasp
skills.description: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.

skills.name: Sap Magic
skills.description: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

skills.name: Bramble Smash
skills.description: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

skills.name: Twisted Advance
skills.description: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

skills.name: Sapling Toss
skills.description: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

skills.name: Nature's Grasp
skills.description: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

skills.name: Double Strike
skills.description: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.

skills.name: Alpha Strike
skills.description: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

skills.name: Meditate
skills.description: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.

skills.name: Wuju Style
skills.description: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.

skills.name: Highlander
skills.description: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.

skills.name: Fired Up!
skills.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

skills.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
skills.description: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

skills.name: Cozy Campfire
skills.description: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

skills.name: Warm Hugs
skills.description: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

skills.name: Breath of Life
skills.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

skills.name: Love Tap
skills.description: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

skills.name: Double Up
skills.description: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.

skills.name: Strut
skills.description: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.

skills.name: Make It Rain
skills.description: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

skills.name: Bullet Time
skills.description: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike

skills.name: Stone Skin
skills.description: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

skills.name: Crushing Blow
skills.description: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

skills.name: Warrior Trickster
skills.description: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: Nimbus Strike
skills.description: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

skills.name: Cyclone
skills.description: Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

skills.name: Darkness Rise
skills.description: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

skills.name: Obliterate
skills.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

skills.name: Indestructible
skills.description: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

skills.name: Death's Grasp
skills.description: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

skills.name: Realm of Death
skills.description: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

skills.name: Soul Siphon
skills.description: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.

skills.name: Dark Binding
skills.description: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.

skills.name: Tormented Shadow
skills.description: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.

skills.name: Black Shield
skills.description: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.

skills.name: Soul Shackles
skills.description: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed towards them. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.

skills.name: We Are More
skills.description: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.

skills.name: Darkin Daggers
skills.description: Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.Packmates leap to attack champions hit by this skill.

skills.name: Hounds' Pursuit
skills.description: Naafiri and her packmates dash at an enemy, colliding with the first champion hit and dealing damage.

skills.name: Eviscerate
skills.description: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.

skills.name: The Call of the Pack
skills.description: Naafiri empowers her pack and spawns additional packmates, instantly receiving a burst of speed and vision and gaining a shield the first time she hits another champion.After killing another champion for the first time, all effects are refreshed.

skills.name: Surging Tides
skills.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

skills.name: Aqua Prison
skills.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

skills.name: Ebb and Flow
skills.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

skills.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
skills.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

skills.name: Tidal Wave
skills.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

skills.name: Soul Eater
skills.description: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.

skills.name: Siphoning Strike
skills.description: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

skills.name: Wither
skills.description: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.

skills.name: Spirit Fire
skills.description: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.

skills.name: Fury of the Sands
skills.description: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

skills.name: Staggering Blow
skills.description: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.

skills.name: Dredge Line
skills.description: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward.  Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage.  Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.

skills.name: Titan's Wrath
skills.description: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield.  While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.

skills.name: Riptide
skills.description: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.

skills.name: Depth Charge
skills.description: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.

skills.name: Inherent Glamour
skills.description: Neeko can look like an ally champion. Taking damage from enemy Champions or casting damaging spells breaks the disguise.

skills.name: Blooming Burst
skills.description: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.

skills.name: Shapesplitter
skills.description: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction.

skills.name: Tangle-Barbs
skills.description: Neeko slings a tangle that damage and root everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.

skills.name: Pop Blossom
skills.description: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and knocked up. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.

skills.name: Prowl
skills.description: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed by 10% for 2 seconds, increased to 30% toward visible enemy champions within 1400 range.Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds. During this time, Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed (increased to 30% toward the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.

skills.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
skills.description: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies.  As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.

skills.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
skills.description: In human form, Nidalee lays a trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages and reveals its target. As a cougar, she jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.

skills.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
skills.description: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with Attack Speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she claws in a direction, dealing damage to enemies in front of her.

skills.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
skills.description: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities.

skills.name: Joy Unending
skills.description: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.

skills.name: Formless Blade
skills.description: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.

skills.name: Jubilant Veil
skills.description: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.

skills.name: Slipstream
skills.description: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.

skills.name: Apotheosis
skills.description: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.

skills.name: Umbra Blades
skills.description: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

skills.name: Duskbringer
skills.description: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

skills.name: Shroud of Darkness
skills.description: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

skills.name: Unspeakable Horror
skills.description: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

skills.name: Paranoia
skills.description: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

skills.name: Call of the Freljord
skills.description: Nunu increases the attack speed and Move Speed of Willump and a nearby ally, and causes Willump's basic attacks to damage enemies around the target.

skills.name: Consume
skills.description: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.

skills.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
skills.description: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it.  The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.

skills.name: Snowball Barrage
skills.description: Nunu throws multiple snowballs that damage enemies.  When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.

skills.name: Absolute Zero
skills.description: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.

skills.name: Berserker Rage
skills.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

skills.name: Undertow
skills.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

skills.name: Tough It Out
skills.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased, he reduces incoming damage, and he gains a Shield.

skills.name: Reckless Swing
skills.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

skills.name: Ragnarok
skills.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

skills.name: Clockwork Windup
skills.description: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

skills.name: Command: Attack
skills.description: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.

skills.name: Command: Dissonance
skills.description: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.

skills.name: Command: Protect
skills.description: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.

skills.name: Command: Shockwave
skills.description: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.

skills.name: Living Forge
skills.description: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resistance from all sources.Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere.Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.

skills.name: Volcanic Rupture
skills.description: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.

skills.name: Bellows Breath
skills.description: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.

skills.name: Searing Charge
skills.description: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.

skills.name: Call of the Forge God
skills.description: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.

skills.name: Mortal Will
skills.description: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.

skills.name: Comet Spear
skills.description: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.

skills.name: Shield Vault
skills.description: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

skills.name: Aegis Assault
skills.description: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.

skills.name: Grand Starfall
skills.description: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.

skills.name: Iron Ambassador
skills.description: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

skills.name: Hammer Shock
skills.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

skills.name: Steadfast Presence
skills.description: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

skills.name: Heroic Charge
skills.description: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

skills.name: Keeper's Verdict
skills.description: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

skills.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
skills.description: When Pyke is hidden from enemies, he regenerates damage that he has recently taken from champions. Pyke also cannot gain extra Maximum Health from any source, and instead gains Bonus AD.

skills.name: Bone Skewer
skills.description: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.

skills.name: Ghostwater Dive
skills.description: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.

skills.name: Phantom Undertow
skills.description: Pyke dashes and leaves behind a phantom that will return to him, stunning enemy champions along its path.

skills.name: Death From Below
skills.description: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.

skills.name: Royal Privilege
skills.description: Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.

skills.name: Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal
skills.description: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element.

skills.name: Terrashape
skills.description: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. Her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while her weapon is enchanted.

skills.name: Audacity
skills.description: Qiyana dashes to an enemy, damaging them.

skills.name: Supreme Display of Talent
skills.description: Qiyana sends out a shockwave that detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.

skills.name: Harrier
skills.description: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies as Vulnerable. Quinn's first basic attack against Vulnerable targets will deal bonus physical damage.

skills.name: Blinding Assault
skills.description: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.

skills.name: Heightened Senses
skills.description: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Vulnerable target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.

skills.name: Vault
skills.description: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.

skills.name: Behind Enemy Lines
skills.description: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.  Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions as Vulnerable.

skills.name: Fey Feathers
skills.description: Rakan periodically gains a shield.

skills.name: Gleaming Quill
skills.description: Flings a magical feather that deals magic damage. Striking a champion or epic monster enables Rakan to heal his allies.

skills.name: Grand Entrance
skills.description: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.

skills.name: Battle Dance
skills.description: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.

skills.name: The Quickness
skills.description: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.

skills.name: Spiked Shell
skills.description: Rammus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage, scaling with his Armor.

skills.name: Powerball
skills.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

skills.name: Defensive Ball Curl
skills.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, amplifying Spiked Shells' damage, and returning damage to enemies that basic attack him.

skills.name: Frenzying Taunt
skills.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him. Additionally, he gains increased Attack Speed for a short time, but this bonus is extended by having any of his other spells active.

skills.name: Soaring Slam
skills.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.

skills.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
skills.description: Rek'sai generates Fury by Attack and hitting with basic abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

skills.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
skills.description: Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that deals Physical Damage and reveals enemies hit.

skills.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
skills.description: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Un-burrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.

skills.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
skills.description: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing double and True Damage if she has max Fury.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.

skills.name: Void Rush
skills.description: Rek'sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their missing health.

skills.name: Break the Mold
skills.description: Rell's Attacks and Abilities steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.

skills.name: Shattering Strike
skills.description: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.

skills.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
skills.description: Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed.Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.

skills.name: Full Tilt
skills.description: Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed.Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.

skills.name: Magnet Storm
skills.description: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.

skills.name: Leverage
skills.description: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.

skills.name: Handshake
skills.description: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.

skills.name: Bailout
skills.description: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.

skills.name: Loyalty Program
skills.description: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.

skills.name: Hostile Takeover
skills.description: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.

skills.name: Reign of Anger
skills.description: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

skills.name: Cull the Meek
skills.description: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.

skills.name: Ruthless Predator
skills.description: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Slice and Dice
skills.description: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.

skills.name: Dominus
skills.description: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.

skills.name: Unseen Predator
skills.description: While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.

skills.name: Savagery
skills.description: Rengar's next attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.

skills.name: Battle Roar
skills.description: Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken.Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.

skills.name: Bola Strike
skills.description: Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration.Ferocity effect: roots the target.

skills.name: Thrill of the Hunt
skills.description: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, Camouflaging him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.

skills.name: Runic Blade
skills.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

skills.name: Broken Wings
skills.description: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

skills.name: Ki Burst
skills.description: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

skills.name: Valor
skills.description: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

skills.name: Blade of the Exile
skills.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

skills.name: Junkyard Titan
skills.description: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

skills.name: Flamespitter
skills.description: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.

skills.name: Scrap Shield
skills.description: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.

skills.name: Electro Harpoon
skills.description: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.

skills.name: The Equalizer
skills.description: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

skills.name: Arcane Mastery
skills.description: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.

skills.name: Overload
skills.description: Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed.On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

skills.name: Rune Prison
skills.description: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.

skills.name: Spell Flux
skills.description: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.

skills.name: Realm Warp
skills.description: Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux.On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.

skills.name: Daredevil Impulse
skills.description: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.

skills.name: Flair
skills.description: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

skills.name: Blade Whirl
skills.description: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.

skills.name: Wild Rush
skills.description: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.

skills.name: Inferno Trigger
skills.description: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.

skills.name: Fury of the North
skills.description: After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage.  Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.

skills.name: Arctic Assault
skills.description: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion.

skills.name: Winter's Wrath
skills.description: Sejuani swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.

skills.name: Permafrost
skills.description: Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.

skills.name: Glacial Prison
skills.description: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.

skills.name: Absolution
skills.description: When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance. Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.

skills.name: Piercing Darkness
skills.description: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.

skills.name: Last Embrace
skills.description: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.

skills.name: Curse of the Black Mist
skills.description: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.

skills.name: Dawning Shadow
skills.description: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.

skills.name: Stage Presence
skills.description: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.

skills.name: High Note
skills.description: Seraphine deals damage in an area.

skills.name: Surround Sound
skills.description: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.

skills.name: Beat Drop
skills.description: Seraphine deals damage and impairs the movement of enemies in a line.

skills.name: Encore
skills.description: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.

skills.name: Pit Grit
skills.description: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.

skills.name: Knuckle Down
skills.description: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.

skills.name: Haymaker
skills.description: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.

skills.name: Facebreaker
skills.description: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.

skills.name: The Show Stopper
skills.description: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.

skills.name: Backstab
skills.description: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal additional damage when striking from behind.

skills.name: Deceive
skills.description: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location.His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.

skills.name: Jack In The Box
skills.description: Shaco creates a hidden animated Jack-in-the-Box. When triggered, it will fear and attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: Two-Shiv Poison
skills.description: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing their Move Speed. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target. The thrown Shiv deals bonus damage if the target is below 30% health.

skills.name: Hallucinate
skills.description: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies (Deals reduced damage to turrets).  Upon death, it explodes, spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes and dealing damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Ki Barrier
skills.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

skills.name: Twilight Assault
skills.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

skills.name: Spirit's Refuge
skills.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

skills.name: Shadow Dash
skills.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

skills.name: Stand United
skills.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

skills.name: Fury of the Dragonborn
skills.description: Shyvana deals bonus damage to dragons and gains Armor and Magic Resistance. As Shyvana and her allies slay more dragons, she gains more bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

skills.name: Twin Bite
skills.description: Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack and grants herself Attack Speed for her next attacks. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite by 0.5 seconds.Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front of Shyvana.

skills.name: Burnout
skills.description: Shyvana surrounds herself in fire, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies and moving faster for 3 seconds, part of this damage is applied again when Shyvana basic attacks an enemy with Burnout active. The Move Speed reduces over the duration of the spell. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout. Dragon Form: Burnout grows in size.

skills.name: Flame Breath
skills.description: Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals damage to all enemies it encounters and leaves cinders on the target, marking them for 5 seconds. Shyvana's basic attacks on marked targets deal a percentage of their maximum Health as damage on-hit.Dragon Form: Flame Breath explodes on impact or at target location, dealing bonus damage and scorching the earth for a short duration.

skills.name: Dragon's Descent
skills.description: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take damage and are knocked toward her target location.Shyvana passively gains Fury per second and gains 2 Fury on basic attack.

skills.name: Noxious Slipstream
skills.description: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

skills.name: Poison Trail
skills.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

skills.name: Mega Adhesive
skills.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

skills.name: Fling
skills.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

skills.name: Insanity Potion
skills.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

skills.name: Glory in Death
skills.description: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

skills.name: Decimating Smash
skills.description: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

skills.name: Soul Furnace
skills.description: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

skills.name: Roar of the Slayer
skills.description: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

skills.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
skills.description: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

skills.name: Fleet of Foot
skills.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

skills.name: Boomerang Blade
skills.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

skills.name: Ricochet
skills.description: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

skills.name: Spell Shield
skills.description: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

skills.name: On The Hunt
skills.description: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

skills.name: Crystal Spires
skills.description: Skarner's presence causes crystals to spawn in set locations around the map. Crystals can be captured by either team by standing close to them. When near crystals his team owns, Skarner gains Move Speed, attack speed, and increased mana regeneration.

skills.name: Crystal Slash
skills.description: Skarner lashes out with his claws, dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies and charging himself with Crystal Energy for several seconds if a unit is struck. If he casts Crystal Slash again while powered by Crystal Energy, he deals bonus magic damage.

skills.name: Crystalline Exoskeleton
skills.description: Skarner gains a shield and has increased Move Speed while the shield persists.

skills.name: Fracture
skills.description: Skarner summons a blast of crystalline energy which deals damage to enemies struck and slows them. Basic attacking these enemies within a short window will stun them.

skills.name: Impale
skills.description: Skarner suppresses an enemy champion and deals damage to it. During this time, Skarner can move freely and will drag his helpless victim around with him. When the effect ends, the target will be dealt additional damage.

skills.name: Power Chord
skills.description: Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

skills.name: Hymn of Valor
skills.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

skills.name: Aria of Perseverance
skills.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.

skills.name: Song of Celerity
skills.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

skills.name: Crescendo
skills.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them. Each rank reduces the base cooldown of Sona's basic abilities.

skills.name: Salvation
skills.description: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

skills.name: Starcall
skills.description: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.

skills.name: Astral Infusion
skills.description: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.

skills.name: Equinox
skills.description: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

skills.name: Wish
skills.description: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

skills.name: Ravenous Flock
skills.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

skills.name: Death's Hand
skills.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

skills.name: Vision of Empire
skills.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

skills.name: Nevermove
skills.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

skills.name: Demonic Ascension
skills.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

skills.name: Petricite Burst
skills.description: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

skills.name: Chain Lash
skills.description: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.

skills.name: Kingslayer
skills.description: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

skills.name: Abscond / Abduct
skills.description: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.

skills.name: Hijack
skills.description: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.

skills.name: Transcendent
skills.description: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional chargeForce of Will: Bonus true damage.Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targetsUnleashed Power: Executes low health targets

skills.name: Dark Sphere
skills.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

skills.name: Force of Will
skills.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

skills.name: Scatter the Weak
skills.description: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

skills.name: Unleashed Power
skills.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

skills.name: An Acquired Taste
skills.description: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health. Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.

skills.name: Tongue Lash
skills.description: Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion.Applies a stack of  An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.

skills.name: Abyssal Dive
skills.description: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.

skills.name: Thick Skin
skills.description: Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat.Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.

skills.name: Devour
skills.description: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.

skills.name: Rock Surfing
skills.description: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

skills.name: Threaded Volley
skills.description: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.

skills.name: Seismic Shove
skills.description: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.

skills.name: Unraveled Earth
skills.description: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.

skills.name: Weaver's Wall
skills.description: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.

skills.name: Blade's End
skills.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

skills.name: Noxian Diplomacy
skills.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

skills.name: Rake
skills.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

skills.name: Assassin's Path
skills.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

skills.name: Shadow Assault
skills.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

skills.name: Bravado
skills.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

skills.name: Starlight's Touch
skills.description: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.

skills.name: Bastion
skills.description: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.

skills.name: Dazzle
skills.description: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.

skills.name: Cosmic Radiance
skills.description: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.

skills.name: Guerrilla Warfare
skills.description: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

skills.name: Blinding Dart
skills.description: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

skills.name: Move Quick
skills.description: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

skills.name: Toxic Shot
skills.description: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Noxious Trap
skills.description: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

skills.name: Damnation
skills.description: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

skills.name: Death Sentence
skills.description: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.

skills.name: Dark Passage
skills.description: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.

skills.name: Flay
skills.description: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.

skills.name: The Box
skills.description: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.

skills.name: Draw a Bead
skills.description: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

skills.name: Rapid Fire
skills.description: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.

skills.name: Rocket Jump
skills.description: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

skills.name: Explosive Charge
skills.description: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.

skills.name: Buster Shot
skills.description: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

skills.name: King's Tribute
skills.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

skills.name: Chomp
skills.description: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

skills.name: Frozen Domain
skills.description: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

skills.name: Pillar of Ice
skills.description: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

skills.name: Subjugate
skills.description: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

skills.name: Battle Fury
skills.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

skills.name: Bloodlust
skills.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

skills.name: Mocking Shout
skills.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.

skills.name: Spinning Slash
skills.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

skills.name: Undying Rage
skills.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

skills.name: Loaded Dice
skills.description: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

skills.name: Wild Cards
skills.description: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

skills.name: Pick a Card
skills.description: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

skills.name: Stacked Deck
skills.description: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.

skills.name: Destiny
skills.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Deadly Venom
skills.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target, dealing true damage each second.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.description: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

skills.name: Venom Cask
skills.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.

skills.name: Contaminate
skills.description: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.

skills.name: Spray and Pray
skills.description: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

skills.name: Bridge Between
skills.description: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with additional benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.

skills.name: Wilding Claw
skills.description: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.

skills.name: Iron Mantle
skills.description: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.

skills.name: Blazing Stampede
skills.description: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.

skills.name: Wingborne Storm
skills.description: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.

skills.name: Echoing Flames
skills.description: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

skills.name: Corrosive Charge
skills.description: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.

skills.name: Purge
skills.description: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

skills.name: Disdain
skills.description: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

skills.name: Fear Beyond Death
skills.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

skills.name: Living Vengeance
skills.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Speed. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

skills.name: Piercing Arrow
skills.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

skills.name: Blighted Quiver
skills.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

skills.name: Hail of Arrows
skills.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

skills.name: Chain of Corruption
skills.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

skills.name: Night Hunter
skills.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining 45 Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

skills.name: Tumble
skills.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.

skills.name: Silver Bolts
skills.description: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.

skills.name: Condemn
skills.description: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

skills.name: Final Hour
skills.description: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter

skills.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
skills.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

skills.name: Baleful Strike
skills.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

skills.name: Dark Matter
skills.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

skills.name: Event Horizon
skills.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

skills.name: Primordial Burst
skills.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

skills.name: Organic Deconstruction
skills.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

skills.name: Plasma Fission
skills.description: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.

skills.name: Void Rift
skills.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.

skills.name: Tectonic Disruption
skills.description: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.

skills.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
skills.description: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.

skills.name: Doom 'n Gloom
skills.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

skills.name: Mistral Bolt
skills.description: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

skills.name: Personal Space
skills.description: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

skills.name: Looming Darkness
skills.description: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

skills.name: Shadow Surge
skills.description: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion.  Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

skills.name: Blast Shield
skills.description: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.

skills.name: Vault Breaker
skills.description: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.

skills.name: Denting Blows
skills.description: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.

skills.name: Relentless Force
skills.description: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.

skills.name: Cease and Desist
skills.description: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.

skills.name: Sovereign's Domination
skills.description: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.

skills.name: Blade of the Ruined King
skills.description: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health.Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.

skills.name: Spectral Maw
skills.description: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.

skills.name: Harrowed Path
skills.description: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.

skills.name: Heartbreaker
skills.description: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.

skills.name: Glorious Evolution
skills.description: Viktor can augment his basic abilities when he gets kills on enemies.

skills.name: Siphon Power
skills.description: Viktor blasts an enemy unit dealing magic damage, gaining a shield and empowering his next basic attack.Augment: Siphon Power's shield is increased by 60% and Viktor gains bonus Move Speed after casting.

skills.name: Gravity Field
skills.description: Viktor conjures a heavy gravitational field that slows enemies in its radius. Enemies who stay within the device for too long are stunned.Augment: Viktor's non-periodic spells apply a slow to enemies.

skills.name: Death Ray
skills.description: Viktor uses his robotic arm to fire a chaos beam that cuts across the field in a line, dealing damage to all enemies in its path.Augment: An explosion follows the Death Ray's wake, dealing magic damage.

skills.name: Chaos Storm
skills.description: Viktor conjures a singularity on the field which deals magic damage and interrupts enemy channels. The singularity then periodically does magic damage to all nearby enemies. Viktor can redirect the singularity.Augment: The Chaos Storm moves 25% faster.

skills.name: Crimson Pact
skills.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

skills.name: Transfusion
skills.description: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.

skills.name: Sanguine Pool
skills.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

skills.name: Tides of Blood
skills.description: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.

skills.name: Hemoplague
skills.description: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

skills.name: The Relentless Storm
skills.description: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Thundering Smash
skills.description: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.

skills.name: Frenzied Maul
skills.description: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them.  Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.

skills.name: Sky Splitter
skills.description: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.

skills.name: Stormbringer
skills.description: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health.  Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.

skills.name: Eternal Hunger
skills.description: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.

skills.name: Jaws of the Beast
skills.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

skills.name: Blood Hunt
skills.description: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 20% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.

skills.name: Primal Howl
skills.description: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.

skills.name: Infinite Duress
skills.description: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Clean Cuts
skills.description: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather.

skills.name: Double Daggers
skills.description: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.

skills.name: Deadly Plumage
skills.description: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.

skills.name: Bladecaller
skills.description: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.

skills.name: Featherstorm
skills.description: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.

skills.name: Mana Surge
skills.description: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

skills.name: Arcanopulse
skills.description: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

skills.name: Eye of Destruction
skills.description: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.

skills.name: Shocking Orb
skills.description: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

skills.name: Rite of the Arcane
skills.description: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.

skills.name: Determination
